derivation: from H4449 (מְלַל) (in the sense of cropping (compare H4135 (מוּל)));
def: a head of grain (as cut off)

occurrences.text: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour, then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour’s standing corn.
